bundles.title: Small pair VMM and completion qualification
bundles.code: Included example; CUDA compilation and execution pending
prereq: Pinned CUDA12.x and actual UUID pair
CPU example checks and CUDA probe build
Read-only topology proves selected UUID pair has intended direct NVLink connectivity
steps: Validate controller receipt and visible UUIDs before GPU work
Query sm_70, VMM and bidirectional peer capability
Create two small owner allocations in one canonical VA, explicit permissions
Write disjoint explicit-index ranges; join via cross-device events
Read and verify whole range from both GPUs, then release only owned resources
accept: Both SM verification paths correct
Actual rounded bytes and UUIDs recorded
No claim of app transparency or physical NVLink saturation
stop: Any mismatch, timeout or uncertain cleanup

bundles.title: Observed consumer ABI and device boundary closure
prereq: B01 or equivalent accepted pair proof
Pinned binary/DSO/symbol manifest
Small synthetic consumer with same entry-point paths
steps: Run native control and facade process separately
Check one logical device, properties and allocation/copy/query/free
Exercise observed runtime plus direct Driver VMM and versioned function-pointer path
Test joined streams/events, default-stream mode and argument lifetime
Capture unknown/bypassed entries; stop before unsupported side effects
accept: Observed surface is mediated consistently
Outputs and required ordering correct
Actual transparency tier and unsupported entries recorded

bundles.title: First consumer and selected regression/operation check
bundles.code: Fixture implemented by V200-05/06; operation subset extended by V200-08/10
prereq: Accepted B01/B02
Existing authorized model fixture
Exact native/facade inputs/configuration and expected output contract
steps: Run one small fixed workload in native control and facade
Assert ordinary single logical device selection without physical split flags
Check output/logits or selected operator oracle
For accelerated variant, verify useful selected work on both physical devices
Record cold/steady intervals separately; do not claim broad performance from smoke
accept: Correct real application run for the stated tier
No hidden offload/quantization/context changes
Focused changed-boundary regression only

bundles.title: Resident capacity exceeding a single V100
prereq: Accepted B03
Both owners have explicit live-free headroom
Chosen live payload exceeds either constituent capacity; around24GiB is a suggested fixture, not an assumption
steps: Check budget including application workspace and reserves
Exercise one logical spanning allocation and the selected consumer resident fixture
Record physical owner backing and live residency; prohibit silent CPU/managed offload
Check results and limited free/reallocation lifecycle
Stop without shrinking the proof when headroom is insufficient
accept: Actual live resident payload exceeds each single-GPU available capacity
Correct output and accounting
No generic32GB-free claim

bundles.title: Matched pair performance decision
prereq: Accepted correctness and capacity/operator prerequisites
Same source/binary/model/shape/precision/fit settings
Idle/contamination checks and native pair baseline
steps: Warm chosen paths once; use a small fixed sample set, initially5 repeats
Compare native owner where fitting, facade-owner, strongest native pair and V200 split
Separate prefill and decode; include communication/conversion/materialization
Retain raw samples and matched timing boundaries
Promote, reject or open D04; only add cases when they resolve that decision
accept: Correctness before timing interpretation
Repeatability and application cost boundary stated
No low-level timing presented as a whole-application speedup
stop: Wall cap reached => remaining cases NOT_RUN

bundles.title: Two logical devices on all four physical GPUs
prereq: Each pair separately qualified
Both logical IDs and full directed physical topology identified
Explicit four-GPU window
steps: Verify two logical devices and both underlying UUID pairs
Check eligible endpoint copies in each required direction
Do not advertise arbitrary peer-pointer access when a constituent cannot map it
Run one ordinary two-logical-device consumer configuration and matched native control
Record inter-pair transfer cost and all owned-resource release
accept: Correct two-device presentation and useful application output
Topology is respected internally
Pair and four-device results remain separate

Native supported alternative baseline
Root scope plus user approval for private/system-affecting mechanisms
Safe rollback and no foreign state changes

Keep useful work, correctness and lifetime contract equal
